instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: OutsideBloom Disclosure Review overview: The project reviews employee outside-work disclosures. Employees submit role, organization, and planned-start details; line managers record operational impact; ethics reviewers record conflict assessments and restrictions; HR case officers record communicated restrictions and acknowledgements; and HR compliance officers record final decisions after required inputs are present. Organization-name visibility, conflict categories, disclosure authority, and decision timing remain unresolved. Payroll processing and performance appraisal are excluded.

output.summary: OutsideBloom Disclosure Review reviews employee outside-work disclosures through operational, ethics, case-handling, and compliance inputs. Employees, Line Managers, Ethics Reviewers, HR Case Officers, and HR Compliance Officers perform the related submission, assessment, restriction, acknowledgement, and decision activities. Organization-name visibility, conflict categories, disclosure authority, and decision timing remain unresolved, while payroll processing and performance appraisal are excluded.
key_capabilities: Submit outside-work disclosures with role, organization, and planned-start details.
Record communicated restrictions and Employee acknowledgements.
Record final decisions after required inputs are present.
unresolved_points: Whether the Line Manager may view the external organization's name without Employee agreement.
Which role may authorize disclosure of the external organization's name.
What maximum time applies to deciding an outside-work disclosure.
